name: The chaotic romance of Seija
source:
The chaotic romance of Seija is a fanmade hentai visual novel from the Touhou Project series.

The game takes place after the Impossible Spellcard event. Seija, defeated now comes back to the Shining Needle Castle to find Shinmyoumaru. She is sadened by her failure and wishes to convince Shinmyoumaru to give her the power of the mallet. Once again, Seija will try to take over Gensokyo.

Will she be able to get closer to the kobito princess without raising suspicions? And be careful to not get "too close"...

[From [url=https://ezo2.itch.io/the-chaotic-romance-of-seija/]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《The chaotic romance of Seija》是一部《东方Project》系列的成人向同人视觉小说。

故事发生在《弹幕天邪鬼》的事件之后。败下阵来的正邪回到辉针城，寻找针妙丸。她为自己的失败而沮丧，希望说服针妙丸再次把万宝槌的力量借给她。正邪又一次打算夺取幻想乡。

她能否在不引起怀疑的前提下，接近这位小人族公主？也要小心，可别“靠得太近”了……

[摘自[url=https://ezo2.itch.io/the-chaotic-romance-of-seija/]itch.io[/url]]
